temporal_rule: A source retrieved after an event may reconstruct that event only when its event_time is at or before the cutoff. Current catalog membership never establishes historical membership.

instrument_discovery.primary: timestamped historical catalog or qualified contemporaneous capture
instrument_discovery.fallback: current official catalog for candidate discovery only
instrument_discovery.forbidden: using current membership to prove historical eligibility

launch_event.primary: timestamped official announcement or qualified contemporaneous observation

terminal_event.primary: timestamped official lifecycle or delivery event
terminal_event.forbidden: creating a verified terminal from disappearance, recorder availableTo, or last trade

ticker_identity.primary: historical symbolId plus contract attributes when preserved
ticker_identity.forbidden: merging discontinuous ticker histories by ticker text

market_trades.primary: Bybit public historical trade archive with a retained object receipt
market_trades.fallback: healthy official historical kline only as a corroboration diagnostic
market_trades.forbidden: treating a missing HTTP/API result as zero trades

daily_close.primary: last qualifying trade by UTC event timestamp, then immutable trade identity
daily_close.forbidden: forward-fill, synthetic close, or terminal-price invention

quote_turnover.primary: sum(price * size) for canonical unique trades in a UTC day
quote_turnover.forbidden: zero-fill or merging incompatible archive fields

funding_timestamp.primary: settlement timestamp carried by the realized funding observation
funding_timestamp.forbidden: inferring a timestamp from the current fundingInterval

gap_classification.primary: timestamped exchange/vendor incident or preserved observation sequence
gap_classification.forbidden: turning archive/API absence into a terminal event

conflict_rule: Conflicting canonical values, non-identical duplicate funding settlements, malformed records, or unresolved identity assignment are fail-closed; no lower-priority source silently replaces a higher-priority fact.
